requirements.quote: The power supply module PCB must be of surface mount technology and be able to fit in the dimensions of the Device's bottom handle part.
requirements.text: PCB must use surface mount technology and fit specified dimensions.

requirements.quote: Power supply module PCB is of surface mount with a minimum of double-layer PCB type
requirements.text: PCB must be surface mount and at least double-layer type.
PCB dimensions must be 33mm x 33mm x 5mm.

requirements.quote: PCB Mounting: Corner mounted with (6mm x 3mm) head screws measured 28mm from the centre of the screw holes.
requirements.text: PCB must be corner mounted with specified screws and measurements.

requirements.quote: PCB Complexity: Solder Masking, minimum of double-layer and silk screening.
requirements.text: PCB must include solder masking, double-layer, and silk screening.
PCB must meet IPC Class II quality specification.

requirements.quote: micro-USB connector positioned to fit as described in the Step file (body fingerprint scanner Bottom Step file).
requirements.text: Micro-USB connector must fit as per the provided Step file.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be able to be powered from the Lithium-Ion battery and a 5V/2A DC source.
requirements.text: Power supply module must support Lithium-Ion battery and 5V/2A DC source.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be able to be powered by a Lithium-Ion Battery with maximum dimensions of 70mm x 60mm x 10mm. (LxWxH)
requirements.text: Power supply module must support a Lithium-Ion battery with specified dimensions.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be able to be powered by the DC Source rated at 5V/2A with a micro-USB output connector.
requirements.text: Power supply module must support a 5V/2A DC source with micro-USB output.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must have a status indicator that shows when the battery is charging and when is fully charged when the 5V DC source is plugged in.
requirements.text: Power supply module must have a status indicator for battery charging and full charge.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must incorporate a powerpath controller for power switchover between a battery and a 5V DC source when powering the Device.
requirements.text: Power supply module must include a powerpath controller for power switchover.

requirements.quote: The Device must power ON when the Lithium-Ion Battery is plugged into the power supply module.
requirements.text: Device must power on with Lithium-Ion battery connected.

requirements.quote: The Device must power on from the DC source (5V/2A) when the source is plugged into the power supply module even when the battery is present.
requirements.text: Device must power on from DC source even if battery is present.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be able to charge the battery while powering the Device from the 5V DC source.
requirements.text: Power supply module must charge battery while powering device from DC source.
